summary: Hillis, Moraga mayor and JCRC member, circulated a letter arguing Richmond Mayor Martinez's re-posting of antisemitic content might warrant his resignation.
quote: Kerry Hillis, the Mayor of the very wealthy, very white Moraga, and a member of the Bay Area's 'Jewish Community Relations Council' (JCRC) had circulated a letter insisting Martinez' re-posting of allegedly 'antisemitic' social media might warrant Martinez' resignation.
